proposed.name: Range
desc: A weapon that can be used to make a ranged attack has a range in parentheses after the ammunition or thrown property. The range lists two numbers. The first is the weapon's normal range in feet, and the second indicates the weapon's long range. When attacking a target beyond normal range, you have disadvantage on the attack roll. You can't attack a target beyond the weapon's long range.

proposals.note: May instead be a general weapon rule record. This is not a claim that original source collection lacks the paragraph.
